entries.name: Jane Anne Kennedy

expected_cases.charges: Destruction of Selective Service records (the October 31, 1969 Indianapolis raid) — United States v. Donner.
expected_cases.sentence: Four-year sentence reduced to three years for the Indianapolis draft-record action. Began the Alderson federal prison term in 1975. Her November 1975 interview describes seven months served so far and a temporary seven-day furlough; neither is treated as the completed term or final release. The separate earlier Michigan imprisonment concerned the Dow Chemical action.

new_case.charges: Destruction of Dow Chemical magnetic research tapes in Midland, Michigan, in 1969.
new_case.sentence: Served fourteen months at the Detroit House of Correction for the Dow Chemical action, separately from the later Indianapolis federal case. Her 1975 recorded interview recalls the 1970 admission and an interview after release in 1971. Exact custody days and months remain unresolved.

entries.rationale: Primary participant interview documents fourteen months in Michigan, separately from federal case; year precision only.
